text: In this unit Alex gets lost on the way to the station, asks for directions and ends the month at a Christmas market. In this unit you will ask for and give directions, name places in a town, say how you travel, buy a present and order at a Christmas market. The scenes are set in places you may know: the station, the campus, a bookshop, a bakery, a tourist office and a market square.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
